    """Parse CLI JSON output, handling (.venv) suffix."""
    raw = raw.strip()
    # Find outermost JSON object
    brace_depth = 0
    start = -1
    end = -1
    for i, c in enumerate(raw):

            if start == -1:

            brace_depth += 1
        elif c == '}':
            brace_depth -= 1
            if brace_depth == 0 and start != -1:
                end = i + 1
                break
    if start >= 0 and end > start:
